correctness.rationale: The proof treats exact real gain a in [399/100,4] and strictly positive previous/current coordinates. A coefficient bound [a,4] and two explicit scalar estimates show finite entry into [1/4,3/4]^2; five exact rational rounded enclosures give entry into [13/20,71/100]^2. The latter produces an invariant 4D box. On it the maximum absolute derivative contribution is 988176/10^6, plus delayed coefficient perturbation at most 3/1600, totaling 990051/10^6<991/1000. Hence the state map squared contracts, has a unique synchronized fixed point, and all positive orbits converge. The actual checker.py was run and verified the exact inequalities; numerical tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The result settles a global nonlinear basin and synchronization question for the natural nested realization of a published chaotic-map construction, throughout a fixed positive-width gain interval including 3.99 used in its numerical experiments. Uniform quantitative two-step contraction after a rigorously proved absorbing phase excludes all interior nontrivial periodic or invariant probability behavior. This is stronger than a local Jacobian test and addresses the substantive question of whether logistic chaotification survives nested state control; it is neither a parameter substitution nor a numerical-only counterexample.
